title: Macular degeneration and diabetic retinopathy
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's eye condition.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for vision and diabetes.

Vitals: BP 138/84, HR 76, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 98.6 F.

HPI: [Copied Forward] Patient is an 89-year-old female with a history of type 2 diabetes. She reports stable vision but seeks evaluation for ongoing management of her condition. She denies any sudden vision loss or new floaters.

Update: The patient presents today for a scheduled follow-up. She reports that her vision remains consistent with her baseline. She denies any new ocular discomfort or changes in visual acuity.

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Negative
Eyes: Positive (Reported vision changes)
Neurological: Negative
Cardiovascular: Negative
Respiratory: Negative
Gastrointestinal: Negative
Musculoskeletal: Negative

Medication List:
- Lisinopril 10mg daily
- Atorvastatin 20mg daily
- Amlodipine 5mg daily

Exam:
General: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented.
Ocular: External exam of the right eye shows no signs of acute inflammation. Funduscopic exam of the right eye reveals proliferative diabetic retinopathy.

Assessment:
1. Type 2 diabetes.
2. Proliferative diabetic retinopathy of the right eye.

Plan:
1. Continue current antihypertensive and lipid-lowering medications.
2. Continue monitoring for progression of proliferative diabetic retinopathy.
3. Return to clinic in 3 months for routine follow-up.

Electronically signed,
P. O'Brien, MD
October 14, 2026
explanations: Type 2 diabetes with proliferative diabetic retinopathy without macular edema, right eye: E11.3591 (HCC 37 and 298).
